name: Fourever You
description: Four friends navigate college life and chaotic romances as they each find their hearts entangled with medical students across four unique stories.

videos.title: JohanNorth: Part One
videos.overview: Living together strains as Johan neglects meals and time, pushing North’s anger to the breaking point.

videos.title: JohanNorth: Part Two
videos.overview: Distance softens hearts as Johan rushes back, and a birthday trip tests whether love can heal their rift.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Ter tries to avoid his first love, but Hill sparks online rumors by posting a photo of them at dinner.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Hill catches Ter in a lie about being sick and takes him on an impromptu date to a local Thai temple.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Hill confesses his feelings and introduces Ter to his friends as the person he is currently dating.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: A jealous Hill protects Ter at an event, leading to a mutual confession and the pair’s romantic first kiss.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Hill defends Ter from a bully, while Johan has a chance first encounter with the chaotic student North.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: While Ter and North start a new job, Johan is forced to look after a drunk North after a rowdy bar fight.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Johan demands North pay for his damages, offering to waive interest if North obeys his every command.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Johan is upset when North lies about taking a bar job, leading to a tense rift between the two men.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: While North stays with Johan, Ter seeks the truth about Hill’s past and his grandmother’s condition.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Johan saves North from workplace harassment, while Hill and Ter finally resolve their past conflicts.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Johan and North share their first kiss after a rescue, but a case of mistaken identity causes confusion.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Hill leaves for an emergency, triggering Ter’s trauma, while North grows wary of Johan using wealth.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: As the bond between Johan and North grows, the story reveals how Johan first fell for him years ago.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: North gives Johan a symbolic gift before his trip, while Hill and Ter enjoy their new domestic bliss.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: North and Ter find themselves living with their boyfriends after being moved out of their old dorms.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: A flashback reveals Johan’s long-held feelings for North and the circumstances that kept them apart.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: As the main couples grow closer, a new mystery emerges regarding the tension between Tonfah and Typhoon.

videos.title: Beside The Sky 1
videos.overview: Typhoon hides a deep love for Tonfa, buried under family ties and the haunting guilt of his sister’s tragic death.

videos.title: Beside The Sky 2
videos.overview: After his father blames him for his sister's death, Typhoon defies orders and flees with Tonfa for one last trip.

videos.title: Beside The Sky 3
videos.overview: At a new semester’s start, Typhoon avoids Tonfa but confesses their past, choosing to care for him from afar.

videos.title: Beside The Sky 4
videos.overview: Tonfah and Typhoon grow closer as anonymous pen pals, while friends urge Typhoon to move past the "brother" zone.

videos.title: Beside The Sky 5
videos.overview: Tonfa confirms Taifun wrote the secret letters, choosing to woo him as Taifun finally follows his own dreams.

videos.title: Beside The Sky 6
videos.overview: Typhoon risks exposure to confess his love to Tontah, finally revealing the truth behind his secret letters.

videos.title: Beside The Sky 7
videos.overview: Tonfah takes Typhoon to Japan to find his mother, but a confrontation with his father leads to a violent assault.

videos.title: Beside The Sky 8
videos.overview: Tonfah secretly helps Typhoon find his mother, leading to a surprise package from Japan with her contact details.

videos.title: The Sun from Another Star 1
videos.overview: Introvert Daotok’s haunted room sparks a clash with medical student Arthit, who becomes his unlikely protector.

videos.title: The Sun from Another Star 2
videos.overview: Athit and spirit-medium Daotok team up to clear Mean's name, using CCTV and ghosts to find the "real" killer.

videos.title: The Sun from Another Star 3
videos.overview: Arthit seeks Daotok’s help to contact his late mother’s spirit, leading to a tearful family confrontation.

videos.title: The Sun from Another Star 4
videos.overview: Daotok faces a massive emotional crossroads as Khram, the source of his past trauma, begs for a second chance right in front of his "fake" boyfriend, Arthit.

videos.title: The Sun from Another Star 5
videos.overview: After helping Arthit find peace with his late mother, Daotok faints, sparking unexpected feelings in Arthit.

videos.title: The Sun from Another Star 6
videos.overview: Arthit’s bold confession to Daotok is met with cold rejection, but his determination only grows despite the warnings.

videos.title: The Sun from Another Star 7
videos.overview: Arthit and Daotok share a surprise first kiss, but a charming new rival, Tae-min, sends Arthit into a jealous spiral.

videos.title: The Sun from Another Star 8
videos.overview: Arthit’s injury forces a tearful Daotok to face his true feelings. Will he finally agree to be Arthit’s boyfriend?

videos.title: Lately, It's Winter Season 2
videos.overview: Tiger finds comfort living with Duean Nhao’s warm family, while hiding the secret that his father is a mafia boss.

videos.title: Lately, It's Winter Season 3
videos.overview: Tiger confesses his mafia roots to Duean Nhao, but a violent brawl during a football match gets Tiger expelled.

videos.title: Lately, It's Winter Season 4
videos.overview: Tiger confesses his feelings for Duean Nhao to his friends, who plot to give the pair private time on a family mission.

videos.title: Lately, It's Winter Season 5
videos.overview: Faced with losing Nao, Tiger agrees to leave for Hong Kong, hoping to return as someone worthy of protecting him.

videos.title: Lately, It's Winter Season 6
videos.overview: Encouraged to be honest at last, Tiger prepares to reveal the feelings he has hidden for a long time..

videos.title: Lately, It's Winter Season 7
videos.overview: After Tiger's confession, Nao opens his heart as Tiger eagerly tries to turn friendship into romance.

videos.title: Lately, It's Winter Season 8
videos.overview: After choosing love, Nao surprises Tiger with a confession that marks the start of a new chapter together.
